final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Health-chain walk on namespace boutique: only one pod is an outlier in the RESTARTS column - checkoutservice-7ff8466b8f-stklt shows 'RESTARTS 2 (29s ago)' while all other 10 pods show 0. Pod detail: Last State Terminated, Reason Error, Exit Code 2 (kubelet-killed on failed probe, not 137 OOMKilled / 143 SIGTERM). Container logs show the app listening on '[::]:5050' with PORT=5050 and containerPort 5050, and the readinessProbe is grpc:5050 (thus Ready=True). However the livenessProbe targets grpc port 5051, which the application never listens on: pod events read 'Warning Unhealthy 0s (x9 over 80s) kubelet Liveness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service "172.20.2.215:5051" within 1s: context deadline exceeded' followed by 'Normal Killing 0s (x3 over 60s) kubelet Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted'. GetAppYAML(checkoutservice) confirms livenessProbe.grpc.port: 5051 vs containerPort 5050. First observation contradicting expectation = liveness probe port misconfiguration, causing the container to be killed and restarted repeatedly, i.e. the reported 'Service abnormal restart.'
